name: NOOP AI
subtitle: Your strap, your data, on your device.
description: An AltStore and SideStore source for NOOP AI. The iOS IPA is unsigned by design and is signed locally by the Apple ID you choose in your sideloader. NOOP AI has no account, cloud service, or distribution signing identity.

apps.name: NOOP AI
apps.subtitle: A local-first companion for your WHOOP strap.
apps.localizedDescription:
NOOP AI reads a WHOOP 4.0 or 5.0/MG strap you own directly over Bluetooth. Scores, history, goals, and coach memory stay on your device. The optional coach uses only the provider and API key you choose when you send a message.

This IPA is unsigned on purpose. AltStore or SideStore signs it locally with your own Apple ID; NOOP AI does not use a personal developer account or certificate to distribute it.
